content: लेशः [लिश्-घञ्] .²1 A small bit or portion, a particle, an atom, a very small quantity; क्लेश (<ab>v. l.</ab> स्वेद) -लेशैरभिन्नम् <ls>Ś. 2. 4</ls>; श्रमवारिलेशैः <ls>Ku. 3. 38</ls>; so भक्ति˚, गुण˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Smallness, littleness. .²3 A measure of time (equal to two {%kalās%}). .²4 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A figure of speech which consists in representing what is usually considered as an advantage to be a disadvantage and {%vice versa%}. It is thus defined in <ls>R. G.</ls>:-- गुणस्यानिष्टसाधनतया दोषत्वेन दोषस्येष्टसाधनतया गुणत्वेन च वर्णनं लेशः; for examples see {%ad loc.%} (Mammaṭa appears to include this figure under विशेष. See <ls>K. P. 10</ls> under विशेष and commentary.) <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ve. 2. 4</ls>.
